ratings.comment: Literally the WORST professor ever! her expectation were way too high for the students and her feedback on papers was extremely opinionated. She is never gives out A 's and is extremely inconsiderate of people's opinions and backgrounds.
Her grading was extremely subjective and her feedback was often condescending. Very stuck in her own opinions and intolerant of others, ironic given much of the content she teaches.

She seems to be knowledgeable on the topic of world regions and the class was well organized. However, grading was very frustrating. Points were often taken off with no explanation. While I can say that I learned a lot, this class was much more time consuming than I expected. There were discussion posts, essays, and also quizzes.

DO NOT take this class if you care about your grades, it also sucks up so much of your time. The material is understandable, however the grading is completely subjective whereas even if every paper/discussion meets the requirements on the rubric, there will be points taken off with no explanation. Virtually NO ONE will get an A.
